title: Digital out-of-home (DOOH): documented creative specifications by source and venue
scope: 68 records: a 2023 Vistar venue-type spec snapshot, current platform/SSP guidance, selected US media-owner specs, OpenOOH taxonomy and roadside-billboard regulation context. Screen inventory changes constantly; no record guarantees the spec of any specific network or screen.

records.source_access: Public help-center article, 'Updated May 20, 2026'; read in browser (direct fetch returned 403)
records.notes: Canvases are Vistar's 'standard' roll-up resolutions (9:16, 4:3, 16:9, Poster, Bulletin); Vistar may resize and letterbox. Pre-RFP overview dashboard is linked but did not load (system error). During RFPs, Deal Desk specs by venue type and media owner are the source of truth. All creatives need media-owner approval.

records.source_access: Public GitHub repository; spec 1.2.1 dated 2026-02-02; JSON updated 2026-09-08
records.notes: Taxonomy only; defines no creative specs. 1.2.1 renames children to singular (e.g. Airport, Train, Fueling Station), deprecates Transit > Taxi & Rideshare Top (104) for Outdoor > Car Top (307), deprecates Billboard children and High-End Dining, and adds venues such as Spectacular, Window Panel, Moving Billboard, EV Charging Station, Hospital, Urgent Care, Casinos, Convention Center, Bank. Repo README still labels v1.1 'Current Version' and the adoption table lists Vistar on 1.0 (parent/child only).

records.file_requirements: Candidate containers HTML5, JPG, PNG, MP4; video codec H.264; audio AAC/MP3; file size 'up to 5MB?' (open question)
records.source_access: Public GitHub README; marked DRAFT; last commit 2021-03-08
records.notes: Draft candidate standards, not adopted requirements. README mislabels 1080x1920 as landscape and 1920x1080 as portrait. Lists 560x160 and 720x208 as downscales of 1400x400. Proposes letterboxing (not cropping) for mismatches and last-frame freeze for short video in a longer slot.

records.file_requirements: Static .jpg/.png at 72 ppi; video .mp4 with even-numbered pixel resolution, standard bitrate <5,000 kbps, 30 fps; RGB; min/max file size varies by publisher
records.source_access: Public PDF (created 2026-03-26)
records.notes: These sizes reach '85%' of PX inventory per the source. 1920x1080/1080x1920 for Entertainment, Health and Beauty, Movie Theaters, Office Buildings, Point of Care, Residential, Retail, Transit, Urban Panels; 1400x400 and 840x400 static for Billboards, Taxi Tops, Transit; 1400x400 video for Taxi Tops and Transit. Spectaculars and some airport inventory are exceptions. Creative ready 3 business days before launch (7 for spectaculars, airports, controlled inventory). VAST only for video tags (no VPAID). Creative file fixed to first bid per DSP creative ID.
